The Kia Racing team is dedicated to competing
against world-class competition — and winning.
That dedication is part of Kia’s belief that the
knowledge gained in competition can be applied
to the entire Kia lineup to provide you with vehicles
that perform beyond your expectations. The Kia
Racing team includes championship-winning
drivers with proven track records, and after two
podium finishes early in the 2014 season you can
look for Kia in the winner’s circle at racetracks COMpelling deSign
across America in the months ahead. Kia vehicles have captured worldwide attention for their interior
and exterior styling, which represents the collaborative work of
designers who have created a look that makes every Kia recognizable
at first sight. Today, the lineup consists of vehicles that fill owners
as well as Kia’s designers with pride.
